description: This Java abstract class defines a base for MongoDB write models related to 'Thing' change events in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates metadata, provides methods to convert to MongoDB write models, and generates filters based on thing IDs.

classes.name: AbstractWriteModel
classes.description: Abstract class representing a MongoDB write model for Thing changes, holding metadata and methods for conversion and filtering.

methods.name: AbstractWriteModel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Metadata object.

methods.name: toMongo
methods.description: Abstract method to convert this model to a MongoDB WriteModel<Document>.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns the Metadata associated with this write model.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Returns a BSON filter that matches documents with the same thing ID as this model's metadata.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare based on metadata.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation including class name and metadata.
